# Toy sprint packet template

Copy into an owning sprint document only when work is selected. This blank template does not start a sprint. Follow [Toy Studio workflow](../TOY-STUDIO-WORKFLOW.md), current user scope and [SPEC.md](../SPEC.md).

## Intent and decision

- ID, date, status and authorization/source of scope:
- One visible play outcome and why it addresses feedback:
- Relevant source/feedback/acceptance links (sanitized):
- Current behavior/evidence versus hypothesis:
- Two or three alternatives, including a simpler option:
- Selected experiment, material dissent, and why:
- First touch → immediate response → varied repeat → release/stop:
- Comparison/selection rule if two temporary variants are necessary:
- Non-goals and explicitly deferred suggestions:

## Implementation contract

- Accountable builder (same for B1/B2), worktree/branch, base HEAD:
- Owned files, shared-file integrator and foreign work to preserve:
- Applicable requirement IDs and observable acceptance:
- Touch/keyboard alternative, audio, reduced-motion, pause/exit and resize behavior:
- Procedural geometry/state boundaries; object/effect/voice/asset limits:
- Art/audio dependencies, source/provenance and integration status:
- Existing budget authority and exact required checks:
- Actual screenshots plus temporal interaction/feel evidence to capture:
- Physical-device/human observations still required; no invented acceptance:

## Stage ledger

Record actual starts/deliveries, identities and interruption recovery. Tool calls and self-checks do not consume extra stages. Do not overwrite history to reset the budget.

| Stage | State: pending / active / delivered | Owner and candidate identity | Evidence / next action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Builder 1 | pending | | |
| Critic 1 | pending | | |
| Builder 2 | pending | | |

Exception/continuation, only if explicitly authorized: source/date, reason, bounded remainder, additional stage allowance, previous stage counts retained.

## Exact handoff prompts

Replace bracketed fields before dispatch; include actual paths and avoid private context.

**Builder 1:** Implement only the accepted outcome and scope in [packet path]. You own [files/worktree]; preserve [foreign ownership]. Read [required contracts/feedback]. Build the stated repeating play experience with its access/resource limits, and self-check/fix within this stage. Run [required commands and visual/temporal checks]. Deliver exact source/build identity, AC status, evidence and gaps for one independent read-only Critic. Do not launch another design/sprint or deploy outside existing authorization. Checkpoint for interruption recovery.

**Critic 1:** Independently review [B1 source/build identity] against [packet/feedback] using [evidence paths]. Inspect actual interaction/presentation and source; run proportionate missing checks within owned-process limits. Do not edit source, create a sub-panel or start another review round. Return one report with the five evidence-backed score dimensions in the workflow, issue IDs/severity/reproduction/expected versus actual, and unverified scope. Label hypotheses and do not infer child enjoyment or device acceptance. Your score belongs to this candidate.

**Builder 2:** Resume as the same accountable builder in [worktree] with [Critic report]. Address issues by severity/player value, record each disposition and supporting evidence, rerun affected plus required final checks, and inspect final visual/temporal behavior. Deliver final source/build identity, AC/evidence status, remaining defects, and scoped backup/integration instructions. No automatic C2 or B3. If incomplete, preserve the bounded remainder and actual stage history; do not claim completion or independent rescoring.

## Final delivery and playtest handoff

- Final source/build identity, commands/results and measured budgets:
- Critic issue dispositions; final self-check evidence distinguished from B1 scores:
- Known defects, unavailable checks and exact physical-device checks pending:
- Sanitized staged-file/privacy review; backup commit/remote status:
- Integration owner and release status; actual verified URL only if deployed:
- Up to six concise optional human feedback prompts, repeated in the delivery message:
- Next decision boundary (retain/refine/compare/archive/explore), not an automatic new sprint:
